page_title: RBL 0-1 EIN | RB Leipzig v Eintracht Frankfurt 13/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
90+4' This is a yellow card! Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+3' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' That was close by Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
88' Marco Rose has decided to make a change. Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig) replaces Benjamin Henrichs.
87' Substitution. Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) on for Mohamed Simakan.
87' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the right post.
86' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) commits a rough foul. Frank Willenborg stops the game and makes a call.
84' Dino Toppmoller has decided to substitute Mario Gotze and he is replaced by Jens Petter Hauge (Eintracht Frankfurt).
83' David Raum (RB Leipzig) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
83' David Raum (RB Leipzig) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, RB Leipzig are awarded a corner kick.
82' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
78' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) commits a foul and Frank Willenborg immediately signals a free kick.
75' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt.
75' RB Leipzig quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
72' Substitution. Junior Dina Ebimbe walks off the pitch and Kristijan Jakic (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as a substitute.
72' RB Leipzig can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
71' RB Leipzig failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
70' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) gets inside the box and tries to beat Kevin Trapp with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
69' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
69' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. RB Leipzig force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
68' Here is a change. Benjamin Sesko is going off and Marco Rose gives the last tactical orders to Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig).
68' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Christoph Baumgartner walks off the pitch to be replaced by Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig).
65' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after David Raum (RB Leipzig) took the corner.

65' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Kevin Trapp, who pulls off a stunning save! The referee signals a corner kick to RB Leipzig.
63' It is time for a substitution. Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) is on for Donny van de Beek.
62' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Sasa Kalajdzic will be replaced by Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt).
62' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the corner but it's cleared.

61' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) gets to the ball swung in from the corner and plants a close-range header low towards goal, but it's blocked then cleared away. RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
61' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is about to take a corner kick.

61' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. RB Leipzig force their opponents to concede a corner.
59' The game is interrupted now, Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
57' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
54' Sasa Kalajdzic (Eintracht Frankfurt) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
51' Donny van de Beek (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

51' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Eintracht Frankfurt will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
49' Eintracht Frankfurt take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
49' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
49' Donny van de Beek (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
48' A clever short pass gives Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Frank Willenborg blows for a foul after Donny van de Beek (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
44' The game is interrupted as Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is flagged offside.
42' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from David Raum (RB Leipzig). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
41' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by RB Leipzig, is intercepted by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for RB Leipzig.
41' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
38' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
36' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
35' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Kevin Trapp's superb save the ball would have probably ended up inside the left post.
35' A quickly taken corner by RB Leipzig.
35' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. RB Leipzig will have a chance to score from a corner.
31' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) towers above the defence but fails to trouble the keeper, heading the corner kick well wide of the left post from close range.
31' David Raum (RB Leipzig) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
30' Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
29' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
25' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) covers his face with his hands after spurning a great chance. The ball rebounded to him but his close-range header went well wide of the right post.
25' Donny van de Beek (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
25' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Eintracht Frankfurt win a corner.
24' The linesman signals that Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
22' RB Leipzig work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

22' Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) plants a good close-range header towards goal from the corner kick, but it comes to nothing as a defender comfortably blocks the effort. The ball is out of play and RB Leipzig manage to earn a corner.
22' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
19' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Frank Willenborg blows for a foul.

17' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
15' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom left corner is far too weak and Kevin Trapp makes a simple save.
12' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a rough challenge and Frank Willenborg blows his whistle for a foul.
10' David Raum (RB Leipzig) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
9' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and RB Leipzig will take a corner.
7' 0 - 1 Simply glorious! Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) wonderfully times his run onto a cross and thunders the ball from deep inside the box into the top right corner!
5' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
5' Frank Willenborg couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) and blew his whistle.
1' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Frank Willenborg was nominated as the referee for this game.
